notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Arcbound Reclaimer by paying {4}.
When Arcbound Reclaimer enters the battlefield, Yotian Dissident and Sarinth Steelseeker trigger.
Resolve the Yotian Dissident trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting an artifact creature card from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarinth Steelseeker ability, putting the artifact creature card from the top of your library into your graveyard.
Unshakable Tail triggers, creating a Clue token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Yotian Dissident and Sarinth Steelseeker trigger.
Repeat from step 3.
